purpose: Full re-run of suite 101 (UCP Agentic Commerce, all 29 cases UCPA-001..029) proving the conversion from agent-driven prose to the native [MCP-OP]/[MCP-EXEC]/[MCP-CAPTURE]+[REST-OP] runner. suites:lanes reports 25 machine / 4 browser. --no-promote: nothing promoted by this run.
preflightNote: UCP 3.1006.0-pr-7-612c / Platform 3.1072.0-pr-3108-b6ef / storefront 2.59.0-pr-2467-1951-195127f5. Store B2B-store. Machine lane (25 cases, graphql-runner.ts) ran first: 2 pass / 20 fail / 3 blocked. Browser lane (UCPA-001/013/018/029, playwright-edge) ran second: 1 pass / 1 fail / 2 blocked. Merged: 3 pass / 21 fail / 5 blocked / 29 total.

suites.name: UCP Agentic Commerce
suites.note: Machine-lane runner defects (not product bugs) drove nearly all 20 machine-lane FAILs: (1) executeMcpOp() in graphql-runner.ts never applies substituteEnv, so {{STORE_ID}} inside [MCP-OP] bodies is sent literally and rejected 'store_id does not identify an existing store'; (2) AuthOptions in graphql-auth.ts has no resource param and mints from BACK_URL, so any [AUTH role=...]-then-MCP case gets a 401 from /ucp/mcp (audience mismatch); (3) [WAIT seconds=N] silently caps at 300s (graphql-case-parser.ts), so UCPA-021's required >=960s TTL wait never happens -- its PASS is coincidental/vacuous, not a real signal. UCPA-022 is the only clean machine-lane PASS. UCPA-025 BLOCKED is a genuine CSV defect (double-quoted zero_id literal), not a runner bug. UCPA-004/008 BLOCKED are the expected fixture gap (no B2C buyer seeded). Browser lane found a REAL, independently-confirmed product/contract finding: checkout_and_handoff requires shipping_address whenever the cart has no pre-existing saved address (undocumented in the tool schema) -- blocked UCPA-001 (Critical, the suite's one must-pass case) and would have blocked UCPA-018 too but for shared-cart contamination from an earlier run. UCPA-013 BLOCKED as expected (no isolated guest-checkout-disabled store). UCPA-029 FAIL as expected (3rd/4th reproduction of the known, already-filed agent-address-overwrite defect, VCST-5378) -- did not unexpectedly pass. No hand-patching; no bugs filed to any tracker; --no-promote honored.
